decision: ACCEPT - 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX, 3 observations. Custody holds: the subject is unmoved at 498324e5, mode 0444, 24834 bytes, at open and at close; HEAD is 0c58fe1e (D-239); the last COORD heading is D-239; live required-now is 28; file08Pin is live e503b75b; DR-G23 is OPEN and PROPOSED and DR-133 is OPEN and not SATISFIED; all 45 path/digest assertions reproduce from disk with zero mismatches; nothing is applied, executed, sealed, committed, or authorized. The load-bearing motion - v7's leftoverDesign [OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING] becoming [] at v8 - is sourced rather than asserted. v7 retained the leftover on exactly one axis, independently pinned implementations on every D-002 platform, taken from occupancy v2's passProperty and EV-1/EV-2/EV-3 and from corpus v3 listing per-platform copies in whatIsNotAuthored. Corpus v4 authors precisely that axis: sixteen platform-indexed copies of the four D-237 payloads across occupancy v2's four platform tokens, every one of which was found on disk at its cited digest, each equal to the frozen v3 payload digest, with Windows absent per D-002's explicit deferral. D-239 recorded that corpus ADOPTED on dual ACCEPT 0/0. The apparent conflict with D-239's own sentence, that leftover-design remains on leftover-join.v7, is not one: corpus v4 lists closure of that leftover among what it did not author and states the leftover remains until a later leftover-join remasurement against these platform-indexed copies. This join is that remasurement and says so without claiming the corpus performed the closure. leftoverDesign [] also survives completeness testing: all eight members of corpus v4's unauthored set are either forbidden inventions, other rows' property, execution observations correctly ridden on OBL-G23-EXECUTION under D-056 clause 5, or the deferral itself; none is unauthored G23 design. The negative half of G23LJ-V5-M1 survives the motion intact - host-refusal observation and subsequent-session view are qualification in four places and design in none. The partition is complete and coherent: six obligations across six bucket slots, every boolean agreeing with its bucket and rideStanding. Nothing is invented: all 33 distinct digests are accounted-for live pins, the four platform names reproduce occupancy v2's array exactly rather than minting a D-002 list, and no fixture or observation byte appears. All seven prior-finding dispositions hold against the bytes they name, and no live prior finding is omitted or fabricated. All 18 dispatch attacks and 11 independent additional attacks are refuted. The three observations - byte-identical platform copies settled at D-239, two missing version-number disclaimers where no confusion is available, and one compressed count phrase - are recorded as examined-and-correct and request no change.
